raw.attchmntText: Mcleod Russel India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Revised Outcome of Board Meeting dated 14th November, 2026 '.
raw.voiceSummary: McLeod Russel India Limited filed a revised outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November, 2026, to correct a typographical error in the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The company stated the correction is clerical and does not impact financial figures or profitability. Independent auditors Lodha & Co issued an adverse review report on the financial results. The auditors cited significant uncertainties regarding the recoverability of Inter Corporate Deposits aggregating Rs. 2,86,050 lakhs, with Rs. 41,421 lakhs remaining unprovided. Other issues included non-determination of fair values for assets, lease rents, and statutory liabilities, as well as non-recognition of interest on loans. The report highlighted a going concern assumption due to current liabilities exceeding current assets and operational losses affecting net worth. Borrowings have been restructured subject to conditions precedent, and the company's ability to continue depends on fulfilling these conditions and asset monetization.

rows.headline: Press Release
rows.subject: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited receives USFDA Final Approval for Binimetinib Tablets, 15 mg and 45 mg.

raw.attchmntText: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited receives USFDA Final Approval for Binimetinib Tablets, 15 mg and 45 mg.
raw.voiceSummary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited received final USFDA approval for its Abbreviated New Drug Application for Binimetinib Tablets, 15 mg and 45 mg. The approval is for products therapeutically equivalent to Mektovi Tablets. Binimetinib is indicated for treating unresectable or metastatic melanoma and metastatic non-small cell lung cancer. Alembic is eligible for 180 days of generic drug exclusivity for these tablets. The estimated market size is US$ 282 million for the twelve months ending September 2026. The company now holds a cumulative total of 248 USFDA ANDA approvals, comprising 230 final approvals and 18 tentative approvals. This announcement was made on 14th November 2026.

rows.headline: Disclosure of material issue
rows.subject: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue- Intimation Regarding Low Allocation of Cane and Diversion of Cane Centers and Commencement Of Crushing Season 2026-2027

raw.attchmntText: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue- Intimation Regarding Low Allocation of Cane and Diversion of Cane Centers and Commencement Of Crushing Season 2026-2027
raw.voiceSummary: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited disclosed that the Cane Commissioner, Uttar Pradesh, allocated meagre sugarcane to its Simbhaoli and Brijnathpur units and nil allocation to the Chilwaria unit for the 2026-27 sugar season. Substantial cane purchase centres were diverted to other mills. The company challenged this order, but the appellate authority dismissed the appeal on 12th November 2026. The company is challenging this decision before a higher judicial forum. The rejection is expected to significantly adversely impact cane availability, crushing volume, capacity utilization, sugar production, revenue, and profitability. Financial impact cannot be reliably quantified. Crushing operations commenced at the Brijnathpur unit on 14th November 2026. Operations at the Simbhaoli and Chilwaria units have not commenced due to insufficient or non-allocation of cane. Workers at the Simbhaoli unit are on strike demanding adequate cane allocation.

LLP, issued an adverse conclusion. The auditors stated the financial results have not been prepared fairly in all material respects. Key issues include Inter Corporate Deposits aggregating to Rs. 2,86,050 lakhs given to promoter group entities, which are doubtful of recovery. A provision of Rs. 2,44,629 lakhs was made earlier, leaving a balance of Rs. 41,421 lakhs unprovided. The auditors noted that profit for the period is overstated to this extent. Other matters include non-recognition of interest on loans, non-determination of fair value of assets, and pending statutory liabilities. The financial results were prepared on a going concern basis, assuming fulfillment of conditions precedent for restructured borrowings and debt settlement proposals.

raw.voiceSummary: TECIL Chemicals and Hydro Power Limited received a conditional exemption from the Government of Kerala on 14th November 2026. raw.voiceSummary: Setubandhan Infrastructure Limited, NSE symbol SETUINFRA, has not submitted its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The National Company Law Tribunal admitted the application by State Bank of India on 28 November 2022. Sandeep D. Maheshwari serves as the Resolution Professional. The Committee of Creditors approved a resolution plan, but the National Company Law Tribunal rejected it on 24 March 2025. The Resolution Professional continues efforts to secure the records and will submit the results at the earliest.

raw.voiceSummary: Rubicon Research Limited disclosed that the Office of the Regional Director, Western Region, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, returned the application for the fast-track merger of its wholly owned subsidiary, Kia Health Tech Private Limited, on November 6, 2026. The authority cited insufficient shareholder and creditor approval for the fast-track route. The scheme received approval from 88.65% of total shareholders, falling short of the required 90%, despite 99.44% approval from those who voted. Similarly, unsecured creditors representing 71.83% of the total value consented, below the 90% threshold. The company received the order on November 13, 2026, and is evaluating options, including pursuing the regular NCLT process. The company stated the merger is an internal restructuring initiative and the subsidiary currently has no operations, so there is no material impact on business operations.

raw.attchmntText: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
raw.voiceSummary: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY2026-27 earnings call with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The call was held on November 6, 2026. The company reported that all assets except B-80 operated at full capacity during the half-year. Management discussed plans for workovers on wells D1 and D2 at the B-80 field, aiming to resume production by late December or early January. Three new wells are planned for B-80 following workovers. In the Cauvery Basin, the PY-1 field requires intervention to restore gas production, with potential output estimated at 15 million to 20 million standard cubic feet per day. Drilling at PY-1 is contingent on securing firm take-or-pay agreements. At the Dirok field in Assam, current production averages 0.7 million standard cubic meters daily, with potential to reach 1.2 million cubic meters once pipeline bottlenecks are resolved. Additional wells are approved pending evacuation infrastructure upgrades.

raw.voiceSummary: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The report was issued by CARE Ratings Limited on November 13, 2026. It concerns the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue aggregating Rs. 500.00 crore. The issue involved fully convertible equity share warrants allotted between September 18, 2025, and November 7, 2025. The monitoring agency noted no deviation from the objects of the issue. No adverse observations were recorded. There was no utilization of funds during the quarter. The company received Rs. 175.23 crore out of the total Rs. 500.00 crore. raw.attchmntText: Innovision Limited has informed the Exchange about a change in accounting estimate relating to the pattern of consumption of the right to collect toll under the Company's contracts with the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI). The revision has been undertaken in accordance with IND AS 8, Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors, as the Management considers the revised basis more appropriate in reflecting the pattern of consumption of the right to collect toll, considering the seasonal and periodic variations in vehicular movement on toll roads.
raw.voiceSummary: Innovision Limited approved a change in accounting estimate relating to toll collection rights with the National Highways Authority of India. The Board revised the recognition basis for fees payable to NHAI from a straight-line method to a proportionate basis relative to estimated monthly vehicular traffic. This change applies prospectively from July 01, 2026, in accordance with IND AS 8. The revision aims to better reflect seasonal variations in traffic. For the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, the change decreased toll fee expense by ₹23.76 Crores. This resulted in a corresponding increase in profit before tax by ₹23.76 Crores. The total contractual fees payable to NHAI remain unchanged. The Board meeting concluded at 05:00 PM on November 13, 2026.

raw.voiceSummary: Archean Chemical Industries Limited has signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board to explore establishing a Battery Energy Storage Giga Factory in Visakhapatnam. The project proposes a manufacturing capacity of up to 5 GWh per annum with an indicative investment of approximately Rs.2,000 crore through a Special Purpose Vehicle. This initiative follows the company's strategic investment in Offgrid Energy Labs, which began pilot plant operations in July 2026. rows.subject: Incorporation of wholly owned Subsidiary of PFC Consulting Limited (a wholly owned Subsidiary of Power Finance Corporation Limited)- Mahasamund Power Transmission Limited

raw.attchmntText: Incorporation of wholly owned Subsidiary of PFC Consulting Limited (a wholly owned Subsidiary of Power Finance Corporation Limited)- Mahasamund Power Transmission Limited
raw.voiceSummary: Power Finance Corporation Limited has incorporated Mahasamund Power Transmission Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary of PFC Consulting Limited. This Special Purpose Vehicle is designated for the 400KV S/S Pithora transmission scheme. PFC Consulting Limited serves as the Bid Process Coordinator for this Independent Transmission Project under Ministry of Power guidelines. The subsidiary will handle preparatory activities including land acquisition and forest clearance. It will be transferred to the successful bidder selected through the tariff-based competitive bidding process. The Central Electricity Authority and Grid India nominated PFC Consulting Limited as the coordinator during meetings held on 12.02.2026 and 13.02.2026. Chhattisgarh State Power Transmission Company Limited approved this nomination via Letter of Intent No. 02-19/T-26/519 dated 03.07.2026. The announcement is dated 13.11.2026.

Chennai Metro Rail Limited redesigned a critical stretch between Alandur and St Thomas Mount to avoid acquiring defence land. The revised alignment involves constructing Phase 2 of Corridor 5 beneath the existing Chennai Central to St Thomas Mount corridor. This change is expected to save six months of construction time. The additional engineering work involves a supplementary tender worth around 300 crore. Chennai Metro Rail Limited plans a 45-day suspension of train services tentatively in February or March 2027, subject to approval from the Commissioner of Railway Safety. The target for completing the entire elevated stretch towards Sholinganallur is September 2027.

raw.voiceSummary: Precot Limited announced on 13th November 2026 that its Board of Directors granted in-principle approval for the proposed demerger of identified non-core assets. The plan involves transferring these assets, including an investment in Suprem Associates, into a separate resulting company via a Composite Scheme of Arrangement under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The demerged division had a turnover of NIL in the preceding financial year. The rationale includes separating non-core assets to allow management to focus on growth and improving transparency. Existing non-promoter shareholders will receive compensation for shares in the resulting entity, with value determined by an independent valuer. Listing is not sought for the resulting company. The penalties were levied for non-compliance with Regulation 29(2) and 29(3) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Regulations, 2015. The violation stemmed from a one-day delay in furnishing prior intimation about the Board meeting for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The Board noted the delay was unintentional and procedural, occurring while the company expedited financial result declarations during an external credit rating review. The company confirmed that the fines were received on August 14, 2026, and have been duly paid. The Board acknowledged the lapse, strengthened internal compliance mechanisms to prevent recurrence, and directed management to ensure strict adherence to regulatory timelines. The company stated there is no material impact on its financials or operations.

raw.attchmntText: GAIL (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Signing of MoU by GAIL (India) Limited & Krishak Bharati Cooperative Limited with Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board for exploring the opportunity to setup a gas-based fertilizer project in the State of Andhra Pradesh".
raw.voiceSummary: GAIL India Limited and Krishak Bharati Cooperative Limited signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board on November 12, 2026. The agreement explores establishing a gas-based urea plant in Andhra Pradesh. The facility is planned for Mulapeta in the Srikakulam district. It will have a capacity of 1.27 Million Metric Tons Per Annum. The project will be located along GAIL’s Srikakulam Angul Natural Gas Pipeline. The MoU was signed during the 31st CII Partnership Summit 2026 in Visakhapatnam. Officials from all three entities signed the document. The Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh was present at the ceremony. This announcement serves as a press release filed with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited.

raw.voiceSummary: All Time Plastics Limited reported Q2 FY27 revenue of INR174 crores, an 18% year-on-year increase. Gross margin declined to 34.3% from 36.2% in Q2 FY26 due to a 40% to 45% rise in polymer prices and delayed price pass-through. EBITDA margin fell to 7.9% from 11% in the prior year quarter. Profit after tax stood at INR4.2 crores. H1 FY27 revenue grew 9.7% to INR335.1 crores. Polymer processing volumes reached 6,910 metric tons in Q2. The company maintains a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.15. New capacity additions are expected in December 2026. Bamboo facility production is scheduled to commence in mid-November 2026. Domestic revenue grew 36% sequentially. The company targets 15% to 20% revenue growth for FY27.

raw.voiceSummary: Gland Pharma Limited issued a corporate guarantee on behalf of its wholly owned step down subsidiary, Phixen SAS. The guarantee is provided to MUFG Bank Europe N.V. to secure a draw-down amount under a Uncommitted Revolving Facility Agreement. The facility is valued at Euro 50 Mn with an initial draw-down limit of Euro 18 Mn. Gland Pharma extended a corporate guarantee of EURO 20 Mn in favor of MUFG Bank. This guarantee secures the draw-down amount and interest thereon. The facility agreement is valid for 3 years. The corporate guarantee is valid until March 31, 2030. The company may extend the guarantee limit if draw-down limits for Phixen SAS increase in the future. The corporate guarantee is treated as a contingent liability for the company.

raw.voiceSummary: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY2027 earnings conference call held on 6th November 2026. The company reported record quarterly revenue of INR630.5 crores, up 14.3% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at INR82.5 crores with a margin of 13.1%, while PAT grew 25.2% to INR45.7 crores. For the first half, revenue reached INR1,179.3 crores, up 15.1%, with PAT at INR84.5 crores, up 25.4%. The biscuit business grew in the low teens, while the bakery business saw high-teens growth. New product launches in quick commerce and premium segments were highlighted as key growth drivers. The company expects margin pressure in the near term due to input costs but anticipates progressive recovery as price increases annualize.

raw.voiceSummary: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited submitted a press release to the BSE and NSE on November 12, 2026. The release states that Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to dedicate the Devangonthi Marketing Terminal in Bengaluru on November 13, 2026. The terminal was developed at an investment of Rs. 330 crore. It spans 20 acres and has a storage capacity of 77,000 kilolitres. The facility handles petrol, diesel, and Aviation Turbine Fuel. It is connected to the Mangaluru refinery via a 363-kilometre pipeline. The terminal includes 10 automated truck-loading bays and biofuel blending facilities. The project aims to reduce carbon emissions by approximately 40,000 tonnes annually. It is expected to generate over 280 direct and indirect jobs.

The company reported second quarter fiscal year 2027 revenue of INR321.6 crores, a 2% increase from the previous year. Operational EBITDA declined to INR35.1 crores from INR40.9 crores, attributed to commodity inflation. Profit after tax stood at INR22.8 crores against INR25.4 crores in the prior year. For the half year, revenue grew 6% to INR635 crores, with PAT at INR71.5 crores versus INR69.9 crores. The domestic tractor business is expected to remain flat due to drought conditions in key markets like Maharashtra and Northern Karnataka. Export tractor sales are projected to be flat, though a new warehouse in the Netherlands will improve logistics and support future European market growth.

raw.voiceSummary: The Grob Tea Company Limited disclosed litigation against Larica LED Products Private Limited. The financial impact depends on the outcome of these proceedings.

raw.attchmntText: LTM Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "LTM Brings AI-Powered Quantum Error Mitigation to IBM Quantum Functions Catalog".
raw.voiceSummary: LTM Limited submitted a press release to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on November 12, 2026. The release announces that LTM's proprietary AI-powered Quantum Error Mitigation capability, named AI-QEM, is now available in the IBM Quantum Functions Catalog. LTM states it is the first Global Systems Integrator worldwide to publish a function in this catalog. The AI-QEM function allows users to apply error mitigation directly within Qiskit workflows. It uses advanced AI models to correct device-specific error patterns through classical post-processing. This method supports improved result accuracy without additional quantum processing unit time or extra qubits. The capability has been validated on IBM Quantum computers across experiments involving more than 100 qubits.

raw.attchmntText: HEG Advanced Materials Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "TACC Limited signs a non-binding MoU with global lithium-ion cell manufacturer for supply of Anode Active Material".
raw.voiceSummary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited disclosed that its wholly owned subsidiary, TACC Limited, signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with a global lithium-ion cell manufacturer. The agreement outlines a proposed long-term supply of up to 40,000 tonnes of synthetic graphite-based Anode Active Material for electric mobility applications. The arrangement is subject to further discussions and finalization of technical and commercial requirements. The collaboration also includes research and custom development of next-generation fast-charging and high-range battery materials. TACC Limited is currently developing production capabilities for anode active material and graphene. This announcement was made pursuant to SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

raw.voiceSummary: Adani Enterprises Limited submitted a media release regarding its subsidiary Kutch Copper Ltd and Chile’s Codelco signing a strategic Memorandum of Understanding for the exploration of the Kaburkaala copper project in Chile. The agreement aims to link Chilean copper resources with Adani’s integrated copper smelter complex at Mundra, India. The MoU was signed in London during LME Week 2026. This partnership involves capital, technology-led exploration, and project execution capabilities from Adani, combined with Codelco’s geological knowledge. rows.subject: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange about Clarification on the news article published by Moneycontrol on November 11, 2026 titled "Waaree admitted misreporting solar import origin in submission to US trade commission"

raw.attchmntText: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange about Clarification on the news article published by Moneycontrol on November 11, 2026 titled "Waaree admitted misreporting solar import origin in submission to US trade commission"
raw.voiceSummary: Waaree Energies Ltd. issued a clarification regarding a Moneycontrol article dated November 11, 2026. The company stated that the US International Trade Commission investigation covers the Indian solar industry as a whole and is not a case against Waaree. No finding, penalty, or liability was assessed separately against the company. The article referenced past shipments where modules were declared Indian-origin, while US Customs used cell origin for duty purposes. This matter was previously disclosed on June 28, 2026. US Customs and Border Protection confirmed Waaree did not ship modules made with Chinese cells and limited duty liability to a small set of past shipments. No new financial or operational impact resulted from the findings. Possible exposure to anti-dumping and countervailing duties is already reflected in financial statements disclosed on November 2, 2026. The order book rationalization mentioned in the article was disclosed with results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company is evaluating a challenge to the US Customs decision before the US Court of International Trade.
